title: Understanding SOLID Principles
summary: SOLID principles are a set of design principles that help developers write maintainable and scalable code. Learn how to apply them in your React projects.
content: SOLID is an acronym for five design principles intended to make software designs more understandable, flexible, and maintainable. Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) A class or module should have one, and only one, reason to change. Open/Closed Principle (OCP) Software entities should be open for extension, but closed for modification. Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP) Objects in a program should be replaceable with instances of their subtypes without altering the correctness of that program. Interface Segregation Principle (ISP) Many client-specific interfaces are better than one general-purpose interface. Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP) Depend upon abstractions, notconcretions.
author: Juan Bianchi

title: The Power of Tailwind CSS
summary: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that allows you to build modern websites rapidly. Discover why it is becoming the go-to choice for many developers.
content: Tailwind CSS works by scanning all of your HTML files, JavaScript components, and any other templates for class names, generating the corresponding styles and then writing them to a static CSS file.It's fast, flexible, and reliable. With zero runtime, you get all the benefits of a utility-first framework without the bloat.
author: Juan Bianchi

title: Building Responsive Layouts
summary: Creating responsive web applications is crucial in today's mobile-first world. Explore techniques and best practices for building layouts that work on any device.
content: Responsive web design is about creating web pages that look good on all devices! A responsive web design will automatically adjust for different screen sizes and viewports.Using CSS media queries, flexbox, and grid layouts are essential techniques for modern responsive design.
author: Juan Bianchi

title: Next.js 14 Features
summary: Next.js 14 brings exciting new features like Server Actions and partial prerendering. Dive into what makes this release a game-changer for full-stack React development.
content: Next.js 14 introduces Server Actions, which allow you to define functions that run on the server and can be called directly from your components. It also includes performance improvements and a more stable App Router.
author: Juan Bianchi
